A handful of students — including **Ethan Garcia** (22% on a recent artifact, 13% on a quiz), **Isabella Rodriguez** (21% artifact score), **Ella Walker** (37% artifact, 42% quiz), and **Noah Brown** (34% artifact) — are showing consistently low assessment scores that may signal they are at risk of falling behind. Additionally, there are multiple **unreviewed artifact submissions** from the grading assistant flagged across the class that likely still need your final review and feedback.
